usageNotes: Use this to deploy a Ceph Manager (MGR) daemon on a specific cluster node; run it on at least two nodes for high availability (active + standby). The target node must be online and already participating in the Ceph cluster (i.e., a MON or OSD node). The `id` path parameter defaults to the node name, which is the conventional choice — only supply a custom id if you need multiple MGRs on the same node.

examples.summary: Create a Ceph MGR on node 'pve2' using the default id (node name)

tips: A minimum of two MGR daemons across different nodes is recommended for HA; the active MGR handles dashboard and module duties while standbys are on hot standby.
After creation, verify the daemon with `ceph mgr stat` or GET /nodes/{node}/ceph/mgr to confirm the active MGR elected.
The Ceph dashboard and several Ceph modules (prometheus exporter, pg_autoscaler) require at least one active MGR — deploy MGR before enabling those modules.
The `id` must match the pattern [a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9-]*[a-zA-Z0-9])? and is limited to 200 characters; stick to the node name to avoid confusion.
